name: Sikafloor Level Eco
paste:
SIKAFLOOR® LEVEL ECO: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor® Level Eco, August 2024, Version 02.07 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikafloor_level_eco.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor® Level Eco where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2024, Version 02.07).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor® Level Eco is designed for high build applications & often being installed by pumping equipment on commercial & domestic projects.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Applied as an underlayment in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, SikaBond®, Sikadur ®, SikaTite®, SikaTile® & Davco® ranges.
    - Suitable for pumping application
    - Underlayment for commercial & residential floor coverings
    - Levelling of uneven concrete up to 75mm
    - Suitable for new or old internal concrete substrates
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.13.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor® Level Eco
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: ECONOMICAL HIGH BUILD LEVELLING & SMOOTHING COMPOUND
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Green Star (VOC-SCQMD Rule 1168)
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very Low VOC
    - Non-combustible
    - Green Star Certified
    - High strength
    - Economical levelling solution
    - Simply mix & apply - No slaking or re-mixing required
    - Good pot life and working time - slow setting
    - Pump or manual application
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polymer modified cement compound
    - Appearance and colour: Grey powder
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: 1 Gram per litre
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: 1 day cure – 14MPa - 15MPa; 28 day cure – 25MPa - 30MPa
    - Flexural-strength: 28 day cure –5MPa - 5.5MPa
    - Water absorption: Porous
    - Reaction to fire: No hazardous combustion products are known
2.6 System structure.
    | Porous Concrete | Moisture Barrier | Non-porous Surface |
    | Sikafloor® 01 Primer or | Sikafloor®-158 W Fast | Sikafloor® 14 Prep 'N' |
    | Sikafloor® Level Pro | Barrier | Prime |
    | Primer |
    | Sikafloor® Level Eco | Sikafloor® 14 Prep 'N' | Sikafloor® Level Eco |
    | Prime |
    | Subsequent suitable | Sikafloor® Level Eco | Subsequent suitable |
    | materials | materials |
    | Subsequent suitable materials |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg Bag - 48 bags per pallet
    - Shelf life: Unopened bags can be stored for up to 9 months in a cool, dry and weatherproof environment.
    - Storage conditions: Bags must be stored off the floor. Avoid sitting bags in direct sunlight prior to application.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2024, Version 02.07) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Concrete floors should be fully cured, structurally sound, with a minimum pull off strength of 1.5 MPa, clean, dry, and free of surface contaminates and dust for Eg. Concrete must be porous and accept water penetration.
    - Test by lightly sprinkling water on various areas of the substrate. If water penetrates, then a good bond with a selected primer can be achieved. If water beads and fails to be absorbed by the concrete surface contaminants are present then loss of adhesion may occur. Contaminates that are present should be mechanically removed before installation.
    - Concrete must be free of efflorescence and not subject to hydrostatic pressure. If the concrete substrate has efflorescence or high moisture (RH) Sikafloor® moisture barrier system may be considered (Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier
    - + Sikafloor® Prep 'N' Prime + Sikafloor® Level Eco). Contact your local Sika® office for further information. PRIMING;
    - Refer to the primer product data sheet for detailed information regarding primer application
3.3 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Porous Priming.
    - Sikafloor® 01 Primer – Mix ratio diluted 1:2 or 1:3 with clean water
3.4 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - or.
    - Sikafloor® Level PRO Primer - undiluted ( Neat )
    Note: Correct amount of primer should always be applied to the prepared substrate giving good penetration and film build.
    Thin applications may result in pinholing in finished surface or debonding levelling compound from the substrate. Do Not allow primer to pool while drying. On particularly porous (mechanically prepared) surfaces or where the initial prime coat absorbs immediately a second coat is recommended. Average dry time ~20–30 min (per coat)
3.5 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Non-Porous Priming. • Sikafloor®-14 Prep 'N' Prime – undiluted ( Neat ); Note: When applying primer to Non-porous surface use a paint roller and apply one thin even coat. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime must be completely dry (50min+) prior to applying Sikafloor® products. Chosen primer should completely dry prior to the application of Sikafloor® Levelling Systems. High Moisture Content Concrete Priming; SikaFloor® 158 Fast Barrier followed by SikaFloor®-14 Prep N Prime
    - Apply the SikaFloor®- 158 Fast Barrier and allow to dry. Then apply a single coat of SikaFloor®-14 Prep N Prime and allow to dry prior to subsequent application of Sikafloor® Level Ultra.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2024, Version 02.07) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Yield: 12L - 4m2 @ 3mm thickness
    - Layer thickness: 3 - 75mm
    - Mixing ratio: 3.5 - 3.8 Litres of clean, cool water
    - Pot Life: 20 Minutes @ 23°C
    - Initial set time: 80 Minutes @ 23°C
4.3 Waiting time to overcoating. Allow 24+ hours at 23°C prior to the application of floor coverings. Drying is dependent on thickness of application, temperature, air flow & relative humidity. Increased air flow will help with drying speeds in cooler temperatures. Testing moisture content before applying floor coverings is recommended.
4.4 Equipment.
    - High speed heavy duty electric drill, mixing paddle & suitable size bucket - 20L+
    - Purpose built mechanical pump
    - Personal protective equipment
4.5 Mixing.
    - Not mixing for the recommended time or additional water may result in product irregularities and possible product failure.
    - Sikafloor® Level Eco is designed to be mixed in full bags and not part bags
4.6 Mixing - Single Bag Mixing. Mix the entire 20kg bag of Sikafloor® Level Eco with 3.5 - 3.8 Litres of clean, cool water. Slowly add powder to the water while mixing thoroughly for a minimum 2 minutes to a lumpfree consistency.
4.7 Mixing - Multi Bag Mixing Station. Pre-measure the total amount of water for the amount of bags to be mixed. Slowly add powder to the water while mixing thoroughlyto a lumpfree consistency. Mixing time shall be a minimum 2 minutes from the last added bag.
4.8 Mixing - Pump Machine Application. Ensure pump machines are calibrated to avoid excess water in the mixture.
4.9 Application.
    - Pour or Pump Sikafloor® Level Eco, then spread with a long handled gauged spreader to heights as required.
    - For touch-ups, use a flat steel trowel.
    - If vinyls are being installed a skim coat of Sikafloor® Level Pro Finish (smoothing compound) may be required.
    - Areas of application must have fresh airflow to assist with product hydration and drying. Closed off rooms with no fresh air will retard the curing process and possibly lead to product failure.
    - .
4.10 Application - Second applications.
    - If required, a second coat may be applied as soon as the first coat is firm enough to walk on without causing excessive damage, approximately 2 hours @ 23°C but no later than 4 hours @ 23°C.
    - This installation method is referred to as "wet-onwet" and higher temperatures/air flow will mean this "wet-on-wet" second application time window is reduced, therefore the second coat should always be applied as soon as possible.
4.11 Application - Note. If the first application is allowed to dry past 4 hours @ 23°C, re-priming & subsequent applications should be applied the next day - Normal drying times apply (24+ hours @ 23°C).
4.12 Cleaning of equipment. Clean tools and equipment with warm water and detergent while the product is still wet.
4.13 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not install Sikafloor® Level Eco over particleboard, hardwood floors, parquet floors or metal. Sikafloor® Level Eco is only suitable for applications over concrete.
    - Do not mix or apply Sikafloor® Level Eco in temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C and under hot and windy conditions
    - Keep product cool prior to mixing and do not leave bags in direct sun for extended periods
    - Protect from hot or strong winds and extremes of temperature for 12hrs after being applied to avoid rapid moisture loss leading to cracking or crazing
    - All construction/expansion joints in existing concrete must be reflected through Sikafloor® product as soon as possible to do so.
    - Not recommended as a trafficable surface
    - Do not use on sloped surfaces that require drainage (wet areas)
    - Do not use in exterior applications

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. 10°C - 35°C
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.13):
    - Do not mix or apply Sikafloor® Level Eco in temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C and under hot and windy conditions
    - Protect from hot or strong winds and extremes of temperature for 12hrs after being applied to avoid rapid moisture loss leading to cracking or crazing
5.4 Basis of the stated values.
    - Manufactured in Australia.
    - All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor® Level Eco, August 2024, Version 02.07, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikafloor_level_eco.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor Level ECO, version 10/11/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/Sikafloor%20Level%20Eco.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor® Level ECO, version 30/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sds-sikafloor-leveleco.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety.
    - For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet
    - (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
